content.text: This is really common at 5, and it's usually a habit rather than a problem. Tonight, tell him the new plan before bedtime: he falls asleep in his own bed, and if he wakes up he can walk himself back, or you walk him back quietly with almost no talking. Then each time he shows up, take him straight back with the same calm line, like "It's sleep time, I'll walk you back." Staying boring and consistent is what makes it stick.
